description: versions.yaml is the third-party SSoT for the DFE stack. Renovate lives HERE (relocated from dfe-docker, which now derives its pins via `make stack`). PIN FLOW IS INVERTED: Renovate edits versions.yaml ONLY, and `check_versions_drift.py --fix` propagates the SSoT into every mirror (chart values, chart appVersions, appset chart pins, plain manifests). Renovate cannot do that job itself -- it manages helm-values and terraform, but not the appset pins, the Chart.yaml appVersions or the bare `version:` keys, so a Renovate edit to a chart could only ever move ONE of a key's mirrors and left every PR failing the drift check. OPERATOR-COUPLED service versions -- services.clickhouse-version (clickhouse-operator), services.kafka-version (strimzi 0.51 ceiling 4.2.0), services.redpanda-version (redpanda-operator) -- carry an `# image:` annotation rather than a `# renovate:` one: `dfe-stack refresh-digests` resolves their digests, but the VERSION moves by hand in lockstep with the operator, verified against the operator support matrix and `dfe-stack compat-check`. The org preset's allowedVersions rules remain the backstop, gating by PACKAGE wherever the image is pinned.

customManagers.description: The SSoT's own pins. An annotation comment above a `key: "value"` line names the image, so Renovate proposes the bump HERE and the propagator carries it to the mirrors. The org preset's identical manager covers .rs/.py/.sh only, which is why versions.yaml needs its own.

packageRules.description: Stop Renovate editing the MIRRORS of an SSoT pin. These images are pinned in both versions.yaml and a chart; letting the helm-values manager edit the chart copy would fight the propagator and produce a PR that moves one mirror of a key that has up to three. versions.yaml is the only place these are proposed now. Deliberately package-scoped rather than a blanket helm-values disable: curlimages/curl in the forgejo chart has NO SSoT key, and losing Renovate on it would leave it genuinely unwatched.

Group every SSoT pin into ONE PR. The propagator runs per-PR and rewrites whatever the SSoT moved, so splitting the SSoT edits across PRs would mean each one races the others' mirrors. Last rule, so it beats the preset's manager-based groups for this repo. The name is kept free of parentheses and spaces beyond the hyphenation Renovate applies, because it becomes a branch name that shell and git tooling has to handle.
